prompt:
Photographic texture source for a photorealistic racing game set in Salwa, Kuwait, in 1985. Real photograph, not a render, not an illustration. Shot perfectly straight-on with a long lens so it reads as an orthographic elevation: no perspective, no vanishing lines, verticals perfectly vertical. Soft, even, shadowless daylight (bright overcast) so the game engine can add its own sun and shadows. True-to-life colours, fine surface detail: hairline cracks, dust, water stains, sun bleaching.

Front elevation of a row of three small 1980s Kuwaiti neighbourhood shops under one flat roof (a baqala grocery, a tailor, a barber), filling the whole frame edge to edge from the pavement line to the top of the parapet: beige plaster, each shop with a half-raised steel roller shutter, glass shop window, and a blank painted sign board above with no lettering; crates of soft drinks and a fruit stand outside the grocery, a small window AC unit, a fluorescent tube light over each door.

Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermarks; people; cars; satellite dishes; modern LED lights or modern glass curtain walls; flags; strong cast shadows; perspective distortion; any writing on signs.
